ETag.description: Strong ETag, the quoted decimal of the row's version, e.g. "3". Never weak.

code.description: Stable machine code from one of the *ErrorCode catalogs

detail.description: Caller-safe text, never the value sent. On validation.malformed-body: the line and column where the JSON stopped being well formed, or that the body is missing or not an object

errors.description: Present only on validation.failed; at most 100 entries

code.description: A FieldCode wire string, e.g. validation.required

detail.description: Caller-safe text naming what was expected, e.g. `expected boolean` on validation.wrong-type; never the value sent. Absent when the code alone says it

in.description: Where a path variable, query parameter or header travels, as OpenAPI names it. With name; absent when pointer names the input

name.description: The parameter's name as this document declares it, a header's included, whatever spelling was sent; for an undeclared query parameter, the name sent

params.description: What is allowed, by name: exactly the params the code declares in the error catalog, e.g. {"max": 100} on validation.too-long, {"expected": "uuid"} on validation.invalid-value, {"allowed": ["name"]} on validation.unknown-field. Absent when the code declares none. Never the value sent

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer to a request-body member, e.g. /name; "" for the whole body. Absent when in and name name the input

errorsOmitted.description: On validation.failed: the failures found past the 100th and not listed. Absent when every one is listed

params.description: What is allowed, by name, for a code that declares params in the error catalog: {"max": 65536} on request.too-large, the body limit in bytes. Absent when the code declares none

201.description: Created. `Location` is the new greeting's URL.

400.description: validation.failed (a field rule; a body member undeclared, of the wrong JSON type, not parsing or given twice; a query parameter undeclared or given twice), validation.malformed-body

413.description: request.too-large: the body is over the limit, which params.max gives in bytes

400.description: validation.failed: a query parameter not declared (validation.unknown-field) or given twice (validation.duplicate-member), a parameter absent (validation.required), not parsing (validation.invalid-value) or outside its values (validation.unknown-value)

get.summary: One greeting by its opaque id
